text:
Alex Chen: morning team — noticed a sharp uptick in embeddings p95 and a couple customer 5xxs since ~07:05 UTC. Alerts from incident-bot show autoscaler flapping on embed-cluster-us-east1.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-2026-0455 — embedding service latency spike. Pages sent to oncall. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler
Maria Gomez: oncall primary here, taking this. I see the same in grafana — p95 jumped from ~220ms to 3.1s over the last 10m.
Samir Patel: i'm secondary, standing by. any immediate customer-facing mitigation we want?
Alex Chen: customers A and C reported degraded search/assistant responses (long tails). Maria — do you want to force a model fallback to the smaller-embed variant?
Maria Gomez: yes. i'll trigger fallback to embed-v2-small on the affected routemap in a sec. Notifying customers via support playbook.
Jamie Li: quick note — autoscaler logs show repeated scale-up/scale-down cycles, lots of pod churn. suspect health probe timing + startup latency.
ops-bot: Executing action: route:update --service=embed-api --from=embed-v2-large --to=embed-v2-small --percent=100 --dry-run=false
ops-bot: Action succeeded. Traffic now routed to embed-v2-small in us-east1.
Maria Gomez: routing done. watching metrics.
Alex Chen: here's the prom query I used to get the spike (paste):
```
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="embed-api",le="1.0"}[5m])) by (le) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed-api"}[5m])) by (instance)
```
Maria Gomez: after fallback p95 dropped to ~240ms within ~2m. customer 5xxs down to zero.
Samir Patel: great. can we add a short-term mitigation to the autoscaler? maybe bump stabilization window and temp min replicas to 4.
Jamie Li: agree. i'll open a quick PR to increase scaleDownStabilizationSeconds to 180 and set minReplicas=4 for the embed deployment; will link PR.
Alex Chen: linking runbook steps for the handoff: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler#mitigations — follow exact roll-forward/rollback steps.
Maria Gomez: current status: traffic on embed-v2-small, p95 stable, autoscaler still reporting flaps but not impacting customers.
Samir Patel: next steps for overnight: (1) Jamie to merge the stabilization PR and coordinate a low-risk deploy window; (2) Ops to run a controlled scale test and gather start-up latency distribution; (3) follow-up postmortem doc stub by Monday.
Maria Gomez: handing off primary to Samir at 08:30 UTC for the next 6h. I'm on standby until then if anything regresses.
Samir Patel: taking primary @08:30 UTC — will monitor dashboards and escalate if errors > 1% in 10m window. Secondary: Jamie.
Jamie Li: ack. i'll keep the PR diff focused and add instrumentation to the readiness probe logs for quicker debugging.
Alex Chen: customer comms — Support sent initial notice to affected customers and will follow with an update once stabilization PR is merged.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0455 status -> mitigated (customer impact reduced). Recording timeline to incident tracker.
Maria Gomez: quick handoff checklist for Samir: 1) verify embed p95 < 500ms across regions 2) confirm no new 5xxs in logs 3) validate autoscaler metrics (scale events). Runbook link again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler#handoff
Samir Patel: got it. leaving a short summary in the oncall notes doc. thanks team. :thumbsup:
